Top candidates: Bacterial_Wilt, Southern_Bacterial_Wilt, Bacterial_Canker_And_Wilt_Of_Tomato. Let me view one reference from each of 4 different classes.

- Bacterial_Wilt reference (Bugwood_3, ID 5606063): identical setup — same beaker, same brown vascular streaking in stem, same bacterial ooze streaming — sequential Bugwood ID to the test image (5606062)
- Southern_Bacterial_Wilt: similar concept but different container; stem lacks the same brown striping
- Bacterial_Canker / Verticillium_Wilt: leaf symptoms, no streaming test at all

The match to `Bacterial_Wilt` is conclusive.
